verdict.rationale: Undermind's own marketing documents shared workspaces for collaboration ("Collaborate on shared workspaces"). It also mentions team member management, and workspaces hold reports, notes and paper folders that persist across sessions, so collaborators can plausibly view or build on shared research. The evidence is a single thin tagline with no detail on how sharing works. Missing for 10: documented sharing of an individual report or session (e.g. share links), view-vs-edit permission controls, any explanation of how collaborators build on shared work, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
